ConversationUpdate.description:
Allowlist of what a PATCH may change (API §10); omitted fields stay.
`folder_id: null` takes the chat out of its folder.
ConversationUpdate.title: ConversationUpdate

MessageResponse.description:
One SQL row: a user message or a whole assistant turn. `content` is the
AG-UI Message[] bundle the UI renders; a turn may hold several protocol
messages (text, tool calls and results, reasoning).
MessageResponse.title: MessageResponse

ResumeEntry.description: An answer to one interrupt, sent on the run that continues from it.
ResumeEntry.title: ResumeEntry

ResumeMessage.description:
Answers to every interrupt the assistant waits on (API §5), in the
SDK's own `ResumeEntry` shape (`interruptId`, `status`, `payload`):
`{"answer": "..."}` for a question, `{"approved": true}` for a tool.
ResumeMessage.title: ResumeMessage

SessionResponse.description: Everything the frontend needs to open a session, in one round trip.
SessionResponse.title: SessionResponse

StopResponse.description:
Acknowledgement (API §7): the status the assistant has now. A turn that
did not stop within the wait still shows `running`.
StopResponse.title: StopResponse

post.description:
Start an assistant turn and stream it as AG-UI events.

Errors before the turn starts are JSON (401/403/404/409/422). Leaving the
stream only detaches this subscriber; the turn continues and is saved.
Answer a new version of a user question; the old branch stays.
Answer the same question again beside the given assistant message.
Answer what a paused assistant waits on and continue the same turn.
Stop an assistant turn, keeping what it produced so far.
